tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
No MSE price exemption and EMD Exemption will be given to any of the bidders
No consortium and joint ventures will be allowed
Chartered Accountant certified Production certificate indicating similar item production capacity should be more than equal to bid quantity.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer, as an authorized representative, must have supplied, installed, and commissioned items similar in type and complexity to the suggestive items/components for the PSE kit, as outlined in the guidelines issued by the Government of India and specified in Section-V: Schedule of Requirements. The tenderer should have satisfactorily completed at least 30% of the required quantity for a government department in any one of the last five years
The tenderer should furnish the information on all past supplies and satisfactory performance for both (a) and (b) above in proforma provided in SECTION XII of this tender document

The bidder must have successfully completed the supply of items to any Government department similar in type and complexity to those specified in the PSE kit during the Financial Years: 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26, with any one of the following:
A satisfactory work completion certificate issued by the concerned Government organization, along with a certified copy of the previous supply orders, must be submitted.

The tenderer must be a manufacturer who has previously manufactured, tested, and supplied items similar in type and complexity to the suggestive items/components listed for the PSE kit, as specified in Section-V: Schedule of Requirements. The tenderer should have supplied at least 80% of the required quantity to a government organization in any one of the last five years.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer must submit samples of all items being bid for, as per the technical specifications mentioned in Section 5. These samples should be delivered to the office of the Director, Department of Women and Child Development, PWD Building, Anand Rao circle, Bangalore-560009, via post, courier, or hand delivery after the last date of bid submission and before the scheduled date for opening technical bids. Samples will be evaluated for quality, and tenders with incomplete or poor-quality samples will be rejected.

The tenderer quoting as a manufacturer must hold ISO 9001:2015 (Quality Management System), ISO 14001:2015 (Environmental Management System) and ISO 45001:2018 (Occupational Health & Safety Management System) certifications dated before the tender publishing date. Notarized true copies of these certificates must be submitted.

Additionally, the bidder must hold and provide a copy of their own ISO 9001:2015 certification.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The selected bidder must furnish a bank guarantee of 5% of the tender value, along with any additional bank guarantees as specified in the GCC. If the supplier fails to deliver materials within the stipulated time frame, liquidated damages will be deducted from the contract price as per Clause 22 of the GCC

The tenderer must submit 2 sets of sample kits of all specified items, along with a certificate from a Government-recognized or NABL LAB confirming the items are non-toxic and non-hazardous. Submission must be done one day before the last date, and the acknowledgement should be uploaded in the e-portal in the specified column. The department will test the quality of the samples, and based on the technical report by the tender committee, the bidder will be selected for financial evaluation.
No MSE price exemption and EMD Exemption will be given to any of the bidders
No MSE price exemption and EMD Exemption will be given to any of the bidders

The bidder must have a minimum manpower capacity of 40 employees. To support this claim, the bidder shall submit a list of employees for whom the firm is paying Employee Provident Fund (EPF) contributions.
Child labour shall not be employed at various stages of the manufacturing unit and supply, regard an affidavit to this effect shall be submitted in the tender documents
All Sample Testing Costs shall be borne by the tenderer
The successful tenderer will have to get 4 random samples from 31 districts and do the testing and the cost of the testing will be borne by the tenderer
All Products supplied by the tenderers must be Made in India including spare parts.

The tenderer must demonstrate a minimum annual financial turnover for the supply of preschool kits or similar items (inclusive of all taxes). The average annual turnover of the bidder shall be more than Rs.42,00,00,000/- for the last 05 years (2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26). A CA certified Turnover Certificate with UDIN number shall be submitted

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer must submit audited financial statements (Turnover certificate, Net worth certificate, balance sheets, Profit and Loss Statement) for the last five financial years (2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26), issued by a registered Chartered Accountant with a valid UDIN number. A turnover certificate, attested by the Chartered Accountant, must also be enclosed for the last five years with UDIN number.
